title: Statement on Protecting Children (One-Page Text, Untitled-1)
text: = The success of our Nation is reflected in our economic and cultural prosperity and military Right, but our character is revealed by how we cherish and protect the weak, innocent, and wolnerable. All children are uniquely created in the image of God and gifted with both purpose and unlimited potential. We can and must relentlessly pretect our children, homes, and communities from the securge of these shameful tragedies and support families and commun ies to ensure that ell children have opportunity to reach their potential.
